scope: 169 original supplementary case-study units: 92 Form 5 and 77 Form 6. Not a complete syllabus or educator-approved course.
rights: Original notes, scenarios and questions authored for Study. No external book text, question bank or artwork copied.

references.verifiedScope: Index lists KSSM Mathematics and Science Form 4/5 DSKP documents. Embedded PDF contents not individually read.
references.limitations: Index verification does not certify every unit against a numbered standard.

references.verifiedScope: BPK/KPM identity and repository landing page only.
Reference destination attempted; current syllabus text not retrieved. No semester mapping claimed.
Misuse and overuse of antimicrobial medicines drive resistant pathogens; used for the Form 5 antibiotic-resistance concept, without clinical advice.

review.evidence: Each correct answer has an exact quotation and zero-based paragraph reference in its unit reading.
review.language: BC Simplified Chinese, BT Tamil and BA Arabic authored in their respective scripts. Other designated STPM English subjects use English. Fluent educator review remains pending.
review.length: Case readings deliberately concise, generally 85–127 whitespace-delimited words in Malay/English; do not claim 180–260 words. Chinese/Tamil/Arabic word counts are not comparable.
review.pedagogy: Notes explain principle, method and scope. Case readings contain supplied conditions, interpretation and explanation. Questions mix identifying evidence, applying a model, explaining a result, scope and verification.
limitations: Not formal educator approval or exhaustive KSSM/STPM alignment.
Some history, governance, religion and moral units are original analytical simulations rather than detailed syllabus chapter coverage.
No MPM semester or assessment standard mapping was verified because the official endpoint failed.
Distractors primarily use alternative same-subject concepts; assessment calibration and near-miss difficulty tuning remain future educator work.
Language-level suitability of BC/BT/BA needs a qualified subject educator despite script and internal answer checks.
review.distractorCorrection: A review found ambiguous fallback options in 45 three-unit STPM subject groups. The true-fact fallback was removed and replaced with an authored false misconception per affected unit. All 1014 questions checked: no wrong option equals any of the six evidence statements in its own unit. Retrieval prompts distinguish specifically stated principles/limits/methods from broader application and causal questions.
review.scienceCorrection: Yeast gas experiment measures fermentation activity, not direct population growth; starting yeast quantity is now explicitly controlled.
